WF-03 Step 03b: Implement Fix A from src/design/iss-0071-onboarding-realm-sync.md on branch feature/WF03-uat-onboarding-realm-sync-20260616.

Fix A — Pipeline slug injection:
In web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, add two module-level constants near the top of the file (after imports):

  const INJECTED_SLUG           = process.env.ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_SLUG
  const INJECTED_ADMIN_USERNAME = process.env.ONBOARDING_PIPELINE_ADMIN_USERNAME

Then in the test body where `slug` and admin username are defined, change them to:
  const uid      = randomUUID().slice(0, 8)
  const slug     = INJECTED_SLUG ?? `pl-${uid}`
  (and similarly for admin_username if it is defined in the test)

When the env vars are absent: existing behaviour is identical (generates random slug).
When the env vars are set: the test uses those values — allowing UAT-RUNNER to inject the scenario's canonical slug ('swiftroute').

Also update any forms or field fills in the test that use a hardcoded `pl-` prefix for the display_name, admin_email, or hostname to use the injected slug when set.

No production source files modified — this is a test file change only.
